title: Slip Drive
prompt: dance pop euro pop, uk garage, fast and high energy
description: A speed garage weapon built around a wobbly sawtooth bass that breathes and growls through a pulsing LFO filter, with TR-808 drums punching hard beneath syncopated offbeat hats. The track evolves from a sparse, tension-building intro through a rolling breakdown, peaking with layered octave-jumping bass and panned percussive fills before stripping back to darkness.
